offering_description.value: Addus HomeCare provides in-home personal care, hospice and skilled home health services to older adults and people with disabilities or illnesses. Local branches coordinate caregivers, nurses and therapists who help clients with daily activities, provide end-of-life care or support recovery at home.

primary_services.value: In-home personal care and daily living assistance; hospice and end-of-life care; skilled home nursing and rehabilitation therapy

customer_segment.value: B2G: State Medicaid programs, Medicare and the Department of Veterans Affairs; B2B: Medicaid managed care organizations and commercial health insurers; B2C: Private-pay clients and families arranging in-home care

end_markets.value: Home- and community-based long-term care; hospice and end-of-life care; post-acute home healthcare

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Covered personal care hours, hospice days and skilled home health visits or episodes; service fees: In-home care paid for directly by clients or families

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Coordinates caregivers, nurses and therapists to deliver home-based care to patients under payer contracts or private arrangements

geography_served.value: US regional: Selected states across several U.S. regions, including Illinois, Texas and New Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: Nonmedical personal care, hospice and skilled home health

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Referrals from Medicaid case managers, managed care plans, hospitals and physicians; own locations: Local branches handle intake and coordinate visits in patients’ homes

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State agency licensing and Medicare and Medicaid certification or participation requirements for covered home-based care

notes: The exact current state footprint is uncertain.
